Balkan Muslims (Mainly Bosnians, Albanians/Kosovars, Turks and many more) drink because of a number of reasons. Firstly, with the exception of Greece, Cyprus and Turkey, all of the Balkans were under repressive communist regimes. Communism is very secular, so naturally traditional Islamic views died down. Turkey, as a secular nation since the 1920s, has also been a lot more liberal with Islamic Law, but do note that Turkey has restrictions on Alcohol. There’s also a lot of cultural reasons, like how drinking is encouraged as a social activity and is seen as mature.
